status: frozen after both integrated-temperature gates passed and before any regional spectrum, regional temperature, thermal-stress map, v17 inverse coefficient, or v17 lensing score existed
purpose: Define the target-blind instrumental admission rule for an ObsID/CCD/region cell whose frozen sky selection contains events but for which CIAO cannot construct a calibrated response on that CCD.

isolated_reproductions: the frozen event-mean refcoord produced source and background PHA files but no ARF or RMF and CIAO terminated with an empty response-support domain
a detector-projected CCD-2 refcoord produced the same missing ARF/RMF failure
removing refcoord and using resp_pos=REGION produced the same missing ARF/RMF failure
discovery.interpretation: The cell contains a dithered detector-edge event but no calibrated response support under the frozen extraction geometry. This was discovered during planning, before any regional fit existed.

admission_rule.maps_off_selected_ccd: After the unchanged frozen event-mean sky reference is converted through the registered science-event WCS, dmcoords reports a CCD other than the cell's selected CCD.
admission_rule.lacks_source_background_ccd_support: The same ICRS reference does not map to the selected CCD under both the science and matched blank-sky aspect/geometry checks.
admission_rule.action: Record the cell, its source/background event counts, response reference, and mapped CCDs; do not extract or fit that cell. Preserve every other cell and every frozen region unchanged.
admission_rule.no_outcome_selection: The rule uses no fitted count rate, temperature, uncertainty, morphology, lensing observable, gravity residual, cluster label, or tunable threshold.
admission_rule.failure_mode: Any other response-construction failure aborts the run; it is not silently converted into a skip.
